title: How Much Should I Pay Someone to Edit TikToks? UK Prices 2026
meta_title: How Much Should I Pay Someone to Edit TikToks? (UK 2026)
meta_description: UK TikTok editing costs £10–£40 per video from freelancers and £25–£75 from agencies. What's included, monthly options and Creator Fellow at £119/mo.
keywords: how much should i pay someone to edit tiktoks

faq.q: How much should I pay someone to edit TikToks?
faq.a: In the UK, usually £10 to £40 per video from a freelancer and £25 to £75 from an agency. Monthly plans bring the cost per video down.

faq.q: Is £10 a video too cheap for TikTok editing?
faq.a: It can work for simple cuts with captions, but expect less attention to hooks, pacing and brand style. Ask for samples first.

faq.q: Is there a monthly TikTok editing service in the UK?
faq.a: Yes. ContentFellow's Creator Fellow is £119 a month and includes 8 short videos, 1 motion graphics video and 1 podcast edit.

faq.q: Do I need to film the videos myself?
faq.a: For editing-only plans, yes. If you want filming too, the Studio Fellow at £149 a month includes one on-site shoot each month.

faq.q: Can the same edit go on Reels and Shorts?
faq.a: Yes. Vertical 9:16 edits work on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.
